architecture_decisions.rationale: Fix a bug where acks_late with worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks caused chains/callbacks to be permanently lost when a worker crashed after storing SUCCESS but before the broker ack.

tickets.title: Fix chain/callback dispatch on dedup fast-path for redelivered tasks
tickets.description: Fix a bug where acks_late with worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks caused chains/callbacks to be permanently lost when a worker crashed after storing SUCCESS but before the broker ack.

implementation_summary: This change implements 'Fix chain/callback dispatch on dedup fast-path for redelivered tasks' for celery. Fix a bug where acks_late with worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks caused chains/callbacks to be permanently lost when a worker crashed after storing SUCCESS but before the broker ack. Modified files: .github/workflows/python-package.yml, celery/app/trace.py, t/integration/conftest.py, t/integration/tasks.py, t/integration/test_canvas.py.
